mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_dag_step_actions(tenant_id,action_id,admission_id,run_id,task_id) VALUES(#{run.tenantId.value},#{action},#{admission},#{run.runId},#{task}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,action_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT admission_id AS "admissionId",task_id AS "taskId" FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_step_actions WHERE tenant_id=#{run.tenantId.value} AND run_id=#{run.runId} AND action_id=#{action}
SELECT snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE FOR UPDATE
SELECT snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE AND status IN ('ACTIVE','CANCELLING')
SELECT snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('ACTIVE','CANCELLING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,work_sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT w.snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works w WHERE w.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (w.status IN ('QUEUED','ACTIVE','CANCELLING') OR w.status='CANCELLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_control_runs c JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.run_id=c.run_id WHERE c.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND c.session_id=w.session_id AND c.root_input_id=w.root_input_id AND (c.role='WORKING' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_control_runs newer WHERE newer.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND newer.session_id=c.session_id AND newer.root_input_id=c.root_input_id AND newer.role='WORKING')) AND r.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TERMINATED') AND NOT r.cancelled) OR w.status='CANCELLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_inputs i JOIN public.agent_runtime_session_events e ON e.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND e.session_id=i.session_id AND e.input_id=i.root_input_id AND e.caused_by_event_id='control:' || i.input_id AND e.event_type='work.cancel_requested' AND e.payload_schema_id='dag.work.v1' WHERE i.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND i.session_id=w.session_id AND i.root_input_id=w.root_input_id AND i.state='ACCEPTED' AND e.target_kind=w.target_kind AND e.target_id=w.target_id AND e.end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.end_user_id)) ORDER BY w.work_sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works w JOIN public.agent_runtime_dag_admissions a USING(tenant_id,session_id,root_input_id) WHERE a.tenant_id=#{run.tenantId.value} AND a.run_id=#{run.runId} AND a.executor_type='MEMBER'

SELECT w.snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works w JOIN public.agent_runtime_dag_control_runs c USING(tenant_id,session_id,root_input_id) WHERE c.tenant_id=#{run.tenantId.value} AND c.run_id=#{run.runId}

SELECT snapshot FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE AND target_kind=#{owner.target.kind} AND target_id=#{owner.target.id} AND end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL#{owner.requireUser.value} ORDER BY work_sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(*) FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE AND target_kind=#{owner.target.kind} AND target_id=#{owner.target.id} AND end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL#{owner.requireUser.value} AND status='QUEUED'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_team_work_answers WHERE )
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE tenant_id=#{key.owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value} AND session_id=#{key.owner.sessionRef.sessionId} AND (status IN ('ACTIVE','CANCELLING') OR (status='QUEUED' AND work_sequence < (SELECT work_sequence FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_works WHERE ))))
mapper.update: UPDATE public.agent_runtime_dag_works SET revision=#{work.revision},status=#{work.status},snapshot=#{payload},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{work.key.owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value} AND session_id=#{work.key.owner.sessionRef.sessionId} AND root_input_id=#{work.key.rootInputId.value} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_dag_permits(tenant_id,run_id,fence,expires_at,admission_id) SELECT #{tenant},#{run},#{fence},#{expires},admission_id FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_admissions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND executor_type='MEMBER' ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO UPDATE SET fence=EXCLUDED.fence,expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_permits WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.agent_runtime_dag_control_runs(tenant_id,session_id,root_input_id,run_id,agent_id,role) VALUES(#{work.key.owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value},#{work.key.owner.sessionRef.sessionId},#{work.key.rootInputId.value},#{work.request.controlRun.runId},#{work.coordinator.value},#{work.request.stage}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS "sessionId",root_input_id AS "rootInputId",agent_id AS "agentId",role FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_control_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run}

SELECT root_input_id AS "rootInputId",fingerprint FROM public.agent_runtime_dag_commands WHERE tenant_id=#{key.owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value} AND session_id=#{key.owner.sessionRef.sessionId} AND command_id=#{command}
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(#{lockKey},0))

SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_session_owners WHERE AND target_kind=#{owner.target.kind} AND target_id=#{owner.target.id} AND end_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL#{owner.requireUser.value} FOR UPDATE
SELECT clock_timestamp()
